This indicates a potential mechanistic connection where Trihexyphenidyl may influence the pathophysiology of Parkinsonian Disorder through its effects on the basal ganglia. The presence of multiple indirect pathways, all leading to Parkinsonian Disorder, supports the hypothesis that Trihexyphenidyl may exert a role in the development or progression of this condition.
